operating_cost_rule: Full additional annual operating costs from year 1; gross effect ramps. Transition is paid once at time zero.
combined_rule: ADM-01/ADM-02 share one module. Conditional joint cases only; overlap haircut reduces gross benefits, never costs. No case is credited to the funding matrix.
price_rule: Static nominal source bases (administration 2026, tax/gambling 2025), no growth or inflation. Ten-year results are sensitivities, not an official forecast.

debt.rule: Conditional repayment phase only: sustainable funded base surplus, no new deficits or stock-flow adjustments; repayment at year-end, interest benefit from the following year. Reinvested interest is included in principal reduction and cannot be added again. No start calendar year is assumed.

labour.rule: Mechanical hours equivalents using survey availability, not matched jobs, feasible hours, employment effects or budget revenue. No multiplication of individual payroll cases by the survey population.

payroll.rule: Constant annual employment at each hours level, proportional gross, 12 ordinary plus two equal special payments; standard ASVG employee. Employer withholding before assessment, no household transfers, childcare/transport costs, employer contributions or midyear change.
